page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 4 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing a total of 4 vCPUs. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that this instance delivers entry-level performance across compute and memory operations. In stress-ng testing, the single-core CPU performance scored 1103.98 and multi-core scored 2930.09, both placing in the bottom 25% tier. Memory bandwidth testing showed a sharp decline from 163.77 GB/sec for small cached blocks to 20.95 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, which falls into the bottom 10% tier. Similarly, Geekbench scores of 912.0 for single-core and 1991.0 for multi-core reflect limited processing throughput under modern workloads.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.sn1.large is its low memory capacity relative to its CPU core count, combined with weak overall benchmark performance. With only 8.0 GB of RAM and no local storage, it is not configured for memory-intensive databases or high-throughput storage applications. However, its dedicated CPU allocation provides consistent, albeit modest, compute resources. This makes it suitable for lightweight background tasks, basic web serving, small-scale text processing, or low-demand utility services that do not require high memory density or rapid disk I/O.
